description: Source code for retention memory management in Zephyr OS, including initialization, validation, reading, writing, and checksum handling for retention data areas.

methods.name: retention_lock_take
methods.description: Locks the retention device mutex if enabled.

methods.name: retention_lock_release
methods.description: Releases the retention device mutex if enabled.

methods.name: retention_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum over retention data using CRC algorithms.

methods.name: retention_init
methods.description: Initializes retention device, checks memory area size and device readiness.

methods.name: retention_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the retention data area minus reserved space.

methods.name: retention_is_valid
methods.description: Validates retention data by checking headers and checksum.

methods.name: retention_write
methods.description: Writes data to retention area, updates checksum and headers if needed.
